summary: Betaworks Camp is active, but the latest named Spring 2026 Agent Systems cohort has already ended. Official pages publish a recurring twice-yearly cadence, funding/support details, and NYC in-residence format, but no current Fall 2026 cohort theme or exact application deadline is public as of 2026-06-09.

proposed_event.name: Betaworks Camp
proposed_event.description: Twice-yearly Betaworks AI residency with up to $500k investment, NYC workspace, mentors, and Demo Day.

dates.date_range_text: Twice annually: first session begins in March with applications Dec-Jan; second starts in August with applications June-July. Next cohort theme and exact dates not yet published.

sources.title: Camp | Betaworks
sources.supports: Official Camp page states Camp is a thematic investment and in-residence program for frontier-technology startups, has run since 2016, consists of 13 weeks in residence, has twice-yearly sessions, takes place at Betaworks offices in NYC, includes Demo Day, and allows hybrid/remote participation discussions.

sources.title: Camp Application
sources.supports: Official application page says Camp is currently in session/get notified when applications reopen; founders receive guaranteed investment up to $500k, NYC workspace, and network support; page lists two annual sessions, March and August starts, 12 weeks in residence, Demo Day, and up to $250k from Betaworks plus up to $250k from syndicate partners.

sources.title: AI Camp: Agent Systems
sources.supports: Official cohort page identifies the latest Spring 2026 Agent Systems Camp timeline: Camp began March 2, 2026 and ended May 15, 2026.

sources.title: Apply to Betaworks’ Spring ‘26 AI Camp: Agent Systems
sources.supports: Official Betaworks post gives the past Spring 2026 application deadlines, March 2-May 15 program dates, Demo Day week of May 4, in-person NYC format, support, and deal specifics for the completed Agent Systems cohort.

notes: Did not use the Spring 2026 application deadlines as current dates because they are before 2026-06-09 and the cohort ended May 15, 2026.
The official Camp and application pages disagree on exact length, listing 13 weeks and 12 weeks respectively; date_range_text uses cadence rather than a specific duration.
No official Fall 2026 theme, exact application window, program dates, or demo day was found in the checked public Betaworks sources.
